The defense of the squadron. The picture shows Lieutenant Colonel Gabriel (right) receiving a welcome from Lieutenant Colonel J.B. BAUNETT (left), commander of the Eighty-third Squadron when he arrives in Taiwan. The U.S. military once announced that this was just a change of defense. The aircraft and equipment will be retained by the 337th Squadron. Both squadrons use the latest F-104A star fighters.
